F16P.fTerm:
SAFETY DEVICES IN GENERAL

Note(s)

  • Attention is drawn to the following places:[7]
    A01D 75/18, A01D 75/20Harvesters or mowers
    A01F 21/00Threshing machines or baling presses
    B02C 23/04Crushing or disintegrating machines
    B21B 33/00Rolling of metal
    B21D 55/00Working sheet metal or tubes, rods or profiles without essentially removing material
    B23B 25/04Turning-machines
    B23Q 11/00Machine tools
    B24B 55/00Grinding or polishing machines
    B25D 17/10Portable power-driven percussive tools
    B25J 19/06Manipulators
    B26D 7/22Cutting machines
    B27G 19/00Wood saws
    B65B 57/00Packaging machines or apparatus
    B65G 43/00Conveyors
    B65H 26/00Web-advancing mechanisms
    B65H 63/00Handling or winding of thin or filamentary material
    D01G 31/00Treatment of fibres
    D01H 13/14Spinning or twisting
    D05B 83/00Sewing machines
    F21V 25/00Lighting devices.

F16P1/00\\.ja: 機械の運転，または制御から独立した安全装置（身につけるかまたは手に持つようにした目もしくは耳の保護具Ａ６１Ｆ９／００，Ａ６１Ｆ１１／００）
F16P1/00\\.en: Safety devices independent of the control or operation of any machine (protective devices for the eyes or ears, worn on the body or carried in the hand, A61F 9/00, A61F 11/00)

F16P1/02\\.ja: 固着したスクリーンまたはフード

F16P1/04\\.ja: 回転軸で回転するスクリーンまたはフード
F16P1/04\\.en: Screens or hoods rotating with rotary shafts

F16P1/06\\.ja: 溶接のための特殊なもの

F16P3/00\\.ja: 機械の運転制御に関連して作動する安全装置；同時に身体の二個所以上を用いることを要する制御装置（Ｆ１６Ｐ５／００が優先）
F16P3/00\\.en: Safety devices acting in conjunction with the control or operation of a machine; Control arrangements requiring the simultaneous use of two or more parts of the body (F16P 5/00 takes precedence)

F16P3/02\\.ja: 前後に動く部材と同期して動くスクリーンなどの安全部材
F16P3/02\\.en: Screens or other safety members moving in synchronism with members which move to and fro

F16P3/04\\.ja: 運転中互に接近する部分をもつ機械用，例．スタンププレス用
F16P3/04\\.en: for machines with parts which approach one another during operation, e.g. for stamping presses

F16P3/06\\.ja: 機械部分が接近すると危険区域から運転者の身体の一部が引き離されるもの
F16P3/06\\.en: in which body parts of the operator are removed from the danger zone on approach of the machine parts

F16P3/08\\.ja: 機械の動く部分に近づくことを許すドア，カバー，ガードなどの部材のロックと関連するもの
F16P3/08\\.en: in connection with the locking of doors, covers, guards, or like members giving access to moving machine parts

F16P3/10\\.ja: ドアなどの部材のロックが機械を始動させるもの
F16P3/10\\.en: in which the operation of locking the door or other member causes the machine to start

F16P3/12\\.ja: 危険区域に身体の一部が位置した場合機械の運転制御に影響する手段をもつもの，例．フィーラ（Ｆ１６Ｐ３／０８が優先）
F16P3/12\\.en: with means, e.g. feelers, which in case of the presence of a body part of a person in or near the danger zone influence the control or operation of the machine (F16P 3/08 takes precedence)

F16P3/14\\.ja: 機械的接触なしで反応する光電管などの装置
F16P3/14\\.en: the means being photocells or other devices sensitive without mechanical contact

F16P3/16\\.ja: 機械によって動く触子をもつもの
F16P3/16\\.en: with feeling members moved by the machine

F16P3/18\\.ja: 両手を用いる必要のある制御装置
F16P3/18\\.en: Control arrangements requiring the use of both hands

F16P3/22\\.en: for hydraulic or pneumatic control systems

F16P5/00\\.ja: 作動部の運動が不意に妨害された場合カップリングが往復運動を伝えないようにするための緊急手段
F16P5/00\\.en: Emergency means for rendering ineffective a coupling conveying reciprocating movement if the motion of the driven part is prematurely resisted

F16P7/00\\.ja: 機械または装置に対する損傷を防止するための緊急装置（Ｆ１６Ｐ１／００，Ｆ１６Ｐ３／００，Ｆ１６Ｐ５／００が優先）［２００６．０１］
F16P7/00\\.en: Emergency devices preventing damage to a machine or apparatus (F16P 1/00, F16P 3/00, F16P 5/00 take precedence) [2006.01]

F16P7/02\\.ja: 機械の危険状態の発生で機械を停止させることによるもの（異常状態によって影響される軸受中の装置Ｆ１６Ｃ）
F16P7/02\\.en: by causing the machine to stop on the occurrence of dangerous conditions therein (devices in bearings affected by abnormal conditions F16C)
